title: GitNexus Context
description: Structured repository intelligence context for AI agent consumption. Produced by scripts/gitnexus-context.ts and consumed by AI orchestrators and CI gates.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this schema contract.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the context was generated.

analysisMode.description: Whether the dependencyGraph is scoped to changed modules only or covers the full workspace.

changedFiles.description: Relative file paths that have changed relative to the base ref. May be empty on a clean tree.

items.description: Relative file path from workspace root. Must not begin with '/'.

impactedModules.description: Unique module paths impacted by the changes in changedFiles.

items.description: Module path, must match apps/* or packages/* conventions.

dependencyGraph.description: Adjacency map of module dependencies. Keys are module paths; values are arrays of directly-dependent module paths. Scoped to impactedModules when analysisMode is 'changed-only'.

architectureLayerMap.description: Maps each module path to its architecture layer classification.

recentCommits.description: Most recent git commits on the current branch (up to 10). Newest first.

message.description: Commit subject line (first line of commit message).

riskIndicators.description: Risk scores for modules impacted by the current changes. May be empty.

module.description: Module path matching apps/* or packages/* convention.

riskScore.description: Risk score in [0, 100]. Integer values only by convention. Higher means more risk.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this module is considered risky.

affectedBy.description: List of changed file paths that contribute to this module's risk score.
